entry.name: SpanPaths
entry.label: Folders of wide images stretched across all monitors together

entry.name: SinglePaths
entry.label: Folders of individual images, a different one on each monitor

entry.name: DisabledPaths
entry.label: Folders from SpanPaths or SinglePaths that are unticked: kept in the lists, left out of the slideshow

entry.name: SlideshowOrder
entry.label: Order of the images: 0 = random, 1 = A to Z, 2 = Z to A, 3 = date modified (newest first), 4 = date modified (oldest first)

entry.name: SpanFit
entry.label: Where spanned images that aren't pre-split are centered: 0 = on all monitors together, 1 = on the join between the monitors

entry.name: MatchPhysicalSize
entry.label: Scale spanned images so they have the same physical size on every monitor

entry.name: MonitorSizes
entry.label: Corrected sizes of monitors that report a wrong one, as "make model=diagonal in inches"

entry.name: ConfigStamp
entry.label: When the settings were last edited (ms since the epoch); the newest settings are shared by every screen

entry.name: ShowWallpaperHeader
entry.label: Show the "Wallpaper" context menu separator label

entry.name: ShowOpenImageAction
entry.label: Show "Open Image" in the context menu

entry.name: ShowNextIndividualAction
entry.label: Show "Next Individual" in the context menu

entry.name: ShowNextSpannedAction
entry.label: Show "Next Spanned" in the context menu
